articles.summary: Lagos, Nigeria – March 4, 2026 – Tizeti, a West African broadband provider, has completed the rollout of a reward-based internet access platform across all its hotspot locations in Nigeria and Ghana, converting advertising engagement into free connectivity for millions of users. The platform, powered by Google Ad Manager’s Rewarded Web technology, allows users to voluntarily watch short video advertisements […]
articles.title: Tizeti launches Ad-supported internet access in West Africa
